//: WHY THIS EXISTS: nothing type-checked scripts/ at all. CI's `lint` job covers
middleware/src + realtime/src, and the only `typecheck` job covers `display`.
`pnpm test:ops` runs under tsx, which STRIPS types without checking them. So a
type error in production ops code reached main silently — one already did:
Scope is scripts/ops deliberately. That is the code PM2 runs against production
every few minutes, and it type-checks clean today, so the gate costs nothing to
add. scripts/agents is excluded for now: it needs the generated Prisma client to
resolve @vizora/database, and carries 4 implicit-any errors. Widening this is a
separate, tracked job — not a reason to leave the ops path ungated.
Settings mirror what the ops code is actually executed with: ESM, bundler
resolution (so `./x.js` specifiers resolve to `./x.ts`, as tsx does).
